title: a sealed run's own log directory survives the swap
intention: When the tester made a run's instance swap, it carries the swap's copy of that run's own log directory (logs/tester/0/runs/<test>/) into the live run_dir(test)/sealed/ before the swap is removed, so whatever any device wrote there during the run survives the seal. The tester names only its own run dir, never a device's file.
why: Measured 2026-11-14 (2a6adebdd79b's measured): a bounce line the bus wrote at runs/<test>/bus-bounces.jsonl inside a sealed run was read by the proof and never reached the live ~/.cairn/logs, because run_proof and run_exec rmtree the swap. Both of 69cd150dc116's reds ran sealed, so their evidence died with the swap. Consumers: 2a6adebdd79b, 69cd150dc116.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured) and Law 7 (errors permanent in records of truth).
how: A helper in device.py, _carry_run_log(made, test): if made, src = Path(made)/run_dir(test).relative_to(_INSTANCE_ROOT); if src is a directory, shutil.copytree(src, run_dir(test)/'sealed', dirs_exist_ok=True); returns {'carried': [relative file names], 'to': path} or {'carried': [], ...}; an OSError returns {'error': ...} and never raises. run_proof calls it before its finally's rmtree and records the result as evidence['run_log_carried']; run_exec calls it in its finally before rmtree. An inherited seal (made is None) carries nothing. RULE 1: no device filename appears in the tester; a provider does not know its consumers.

clauses.claim: a sealed run whose proof writes a line under its own run log dir (runs/$CAIRN_TESTER_TEST_ID/) has that line in the live logs, under run_dir(test)/sealed/, after the swap is gone
the swap directory the run made is still removed

decisions.text: D1: run_proof and run_exec carry the swap's runs/<test>/ into the live run_dir(test)/sealed/ before removing the swap; a copy failure is recorded and never stops the teardown.
D2: the red-first proof runs a fixture proof through run_proof and run_exec under the real seal, the fixture writing one line at its run's log dir; one tooth per clause.

measured.saw: a bounce line written by a sealed run's bus at runs/<test>/bus-bounces.jsonl was read inside the run and absent from the live ~/.cairn/logs after it
measured.how: 2a6adebdd79b's proof under bin/cairn test --exec, then find ~/.cairn/logs -name bounces.jsonl -newer server.py: nothing

measured.saw: run_proof and run_exec shutil.rmtree the swap in their finally and keep only wrote_to_instance (names, not bytes); no ticket carries a run's logs out
